question: Should this agent activity timeline wait for the metadata-only audit ledger and lifecycle security contract, or should maintainers intentionally scope a narrower ephemeral timeline surface now?
rationale: The user outcome is clear, but the implementation choice controls persistence, cross-session visibility, redaction, authorization, and whether the feature duplicates existing Activity, Logbook, trajectory, and task/audit surfaces.

options.title: Build on audit ledger first
options.body: Use the open metadata-only audit foundation to define durable event identity, redaction, retention, and query semantics before adding timeline UI/CLI surfaces.

options.title: Approve ephemeral timeline only
options.body: Keep the feature session-local or browser-local and derived from existing live events, accepting that it will not satisfy durable JSON export or historical timelines.

options.title: Decline broad timeline surface
options.body: Keep Activity, Logbook, tasks, and trajectory export as the supported observability paths and narrow or close this request after documenting that decision.

recommendation.title: Build on audit ledger first
recommendation.body: Use the open metadata-only audit foundation to define durable event identity, redaction, retention, and query semantics before adding timeline UI/CLI surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the strongest recent product-scope signals for the related audit foundation, Logbook timeline, and adjacent Control UI/plugin work.
